mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.content, p.topic_id, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, t.name AS topic_name, CASE WHEN pl.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked_by_me FROM post p INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN topic t ON t.id = p.topic_id LEFT JOIN post_like pl ON pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE p.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, content, topic_id, like_count, comment_count, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{topicId}, 0, 0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, content, topic_id, like_count, comment_count, status, created_time, updated_time FROM post WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
ORDER BY p.like_count DESC, p.created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
ORDER BY p.created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post WHERE status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET status = 0, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
